name: hive-publish
description: Automates DMs on Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and Telegram, publishes to ten networks, and puts every connected account's analytics in one view. Free for 14 days, no card. Then $6 per connected account per month on Worker Bee, $12 on Swarm, or $85 a month flat on Queen Bee. Priced per connected account, never per contact.
